Additionally, the P/E ratio of -16.54x suggests a negative earnings multiple, which is highly unusual and indicative of potential financial distress or misreporting [E5]. The compounded sales growth over 3 years at -59% further underscores the company's poor performance, as it has not shown any signs of recovery despite potentially positive indicators like strong sales growth in the trailing twelve months of 21% [E16] and a sector median sales growth of 18.6% [E70]. These negative metrics combined with the weak Price-to-Book ratio strongly imply that the valuation does not support the current market capitalization of ₹11.8 Cr, making it evident that there are substantial risks associated with investing in Ortin Global Ltd.
